indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admins_pkey ON vilqa.admins USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX diary_pkey ON vilqa.diary USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX diary_draft_id_item_index_key ON vilqa.diary USING btree (draft_id, item_index)
CREATE INDEX diary_user_day ON vilqa.diary USING btree (user_id, date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_pkey ON vilqa.audit USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX diary_audit_entry ON vilqa.audit USING btree (entry_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX requests_pkey ON vilqa.requests USING btree (actor_id, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profiles_pkey ON vilqa.profiles USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profile_audit_pkey ON vilqa.profile_audit USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX profile_audit_user ON vilqa.profile_audit USING btree (user_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX profile_notifications_pkey ON vilqa.profile_notifications USING btree (user_id, profile_version)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_members_pkey ON vilqa.access_members USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_identities_pkey ON vilqa.access_identities USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_current_username ON vilqa.access_identities USING btree (lower(username)) WHERE (username IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX access_audit_pkey ON vilqa.access_audit USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nav_sessions_pkey ON vilqa.nav_sessions USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nav_operations_pkey ON vilqa.nav_operations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nav_operations_user_id_event_key_key ON vilqa.nav_operations USING btree (user_id, event_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nav_messages_pkey ON vilqa.nav_messages USING btree (user_id, message_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nav_events_pkey ON vilqa.nav_events USING btree (user_id, event_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nav_state_events_pkey ON vilqa.nav_state_events USING btree (user_id, event_key)
CREATE INDEX nav_pending ON vilqa.nav_operations USING btree (user_id, id) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recipe_deletions_pkey ON vilqa.recipe_deletions USING btree (actor_id, recipe_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX meal_notifications_pkey ON vilqa.meal_notifications USING btree (entry_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiber_settings_pkey ON vilqa.fiber_settings USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiber_config_pkey ON vilqa.fiber_config USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiber_cache_pkey ON vilqa.fiber_cache USING btree (cache_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiber_jobs_pkey ON vilqa.fiber_jobs USING btree (job_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fiber_audit_pkey ON vilqa.fiber_audit USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX fiber_jobs_pending ON vilqa.fiber_jobs USING btree (status, ready_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX processing_status_pkey ON vilqa.processing_status USING btree (user_id, kind, scope)

triggers.name: fiber_enqueue
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER fiber_enqueue BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON vilqa.diary FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION vilqa.fiber_enqueue()
